definitions.explanation: The closing period of the summer season, typically late August to early September in Japan. A phrase with strong emotional resonance in Japanese culture, evoking nostalgia, the passage of time, and a bittersweet sense of endings.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}の{終|お}わり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいている→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧。
examples.english: The end of summer is approaching.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}の{終|お}わり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花火大会|はなびたいかい}→花火大会：10105_hanabitaikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a fireworks festival at the end of summer.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}の{終|お}わり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦どこか→どこか：02361_dokoka⟧{寂|さび}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じさせる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: The twilight at the end of summer somehow evokes a feeling of loneliness.

notes:
A set phrase frequently used in literature, songs, and everyday conversation to mark the transition from summer to autumn. In Japanese culture, the end of summer carries particularly strong emotional associations: the end of school holidays, the fading of cicada songs, the last fireworks festivals, and the shift toward cooler weather. It is a common theme in songs, novels, and anime.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夏|なつ}の{終|お}わり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧: the sky at the end of summer
- {夏|なつ}の{終|お}わり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{告|つ}げる→告げる：11808_tsugeru⟧: to signal the end of summer
- {夏|なつ}の{終|お}わり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧: memories from the end of summer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{晩夏|ばんか}→晩夏：19623_banka⟧: late summer — the Sino-Japanese equivalent; more literary
- ⟦{残暑|ざんしょ}→残暑：08559_zansho⟧: lingering summer heat — the heat that continues into early autumn
- ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{始|はじ}まり→始まり：02474_hajimari⟧: beginning of summer — the opposite seasonal transition
